scenario: You are working at a city art museum. Your manager is showing you how to help visitors in the galleries. Listen to the manager and repeat what the manager says. Repeat only once.

sentences.text: Visitors must check large bags at the entrance.
Please remind guests not to touch the paintings.
The east gallery closes an hour earlier than the others.
If anyone asks about tours, they start at the front desk.
We don't allow flash photography, but small phone cameras are perfectly fine.
When a school group arrives, count the students before they enter the galleries.
